# Polyphony

> Type-agnostic SDLC routing engine and conductor workflow suite for Azure DevOps. Polyphony is a .NET 11 CLI that decides what should happen to a work item — phase, transition, branch hint — based on a per-repo `.polyphony-config/process-config.yaml`. It pairs with `twig` (which executes decisions against ADO) and with `conductor` (which orchestrates the surrounding AI workflows). Polyphony itself never writes to ADO.

Polyphony ships two artifacts from one tree: the **Polyphony CLI binary** (`src/Polyphony/`) and the **conductor workflow suite** (`.conductor/registry/workflows/`). They version together but are independent.

## Agent orientation

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical agent guide for this repo. Build, test, lint, do-not-edit zones, cardinal rules.
